title: Development of Optical Research Laboratory with state of art and modern facilities for testing, development and training on AtoN at Marine Navigation Training Institute, Kolkata
summary: Two-cover e-tender to develop an optical research laboratory for testing, development and training on aids to navigation at the Marine Navigation Training Institute, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Marine Navigation Training Institute, Kolkata
sites.work: Development of optical research laboratory for AtoN testing, development and training

scope.item: Development of Optical Research Laboratory with state of art and modern facilities for testing, development and training on AtoN

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of nationalized commercial bank in favour of Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, or valid MSME/NSIC certificate (registration in subject work); original EMD or hard copy of certificate to reach office by 19.09.2024. notes: NIT (Section 1) only, dated 23.08.2024; no equipment list, BOQ or detailed eligibility. Bid submission 23.08.2024 to 19.09.2024 15:00; pre-bid 05.09.2024 15:00; technical opening 20.09.2024 16:00. Portal inferred from reference to CPP portal uploads in note (iii).
